summary: Implemented prepareUpdate following the prepareQuery pattern, without running tests or committing. Changes: (1) rdflib/plugins/sparql/sparql.py adds an Update class wrapping the translated update algebra as self.algebra. (2) rdflib/plugins/sparql/processor.py adds prepareUpdate(updateString, initNs={}, base=None) returning an Update with _original_args set, and SPARQLUpdateProcessor.update now unwraps Update objects to their algebra. (3) rdflib/plugins/sparql/__init__.py exports prepareUpdate. (4) test/test_sparql.py adds test_prepare_update, which checks the returned type and that applying the prepared update matches applying the string form. The test has not been run, so it is unverified. Nothing is committed.
